evals.name: routing-triggers
evals.prompt: bring this project's CLAUDE.md up to date with my usual rules
evals.expected_output: claudemd-patch loads and inserts the standard Test-Writing Policy and Code Conventions blocks, plus the PreToolUse write-tests hook in .claude/settings.json.

evals.name: routing-excludes-claudemd-compact
evals.prompt: this CLAUDE.md is way too long, trim it down and move the detail out
evals.expected_output: Shrinking and reorganizing an existing CLAUDE.md is claudemd-compact's job; claudemd-patch must not load, because it adds fixed blocks rather than compacting.
